name: Kagura Issa
source:
He has an egocentric and high-handed personality—a so-called "Ore-sama" type character. He also has a narcissistic side, being very confident in his own appearance. He falls in love at first sight with the manager (you) after their fateful encounter.

While he is always full of confidence, he shows a bit of his true self in the "Romance Route Expansion." You might even see a side of him acting spoiled or getting excited...!?

[Taken from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/4067070?emclan=103582791475364566&emgid=523112945526244357]Steam[/url]]
